verse.unicode: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ

transliteration.english: soraTh mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa titukee

en.bdb: Sorat'h, Third Mehla, First House, Thi-Thukay:

verse.unicode: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥

transliteration.english: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਾ ਦੀ ਸਦਾ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਤੂ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: bhagataa dhee sadhaa too rakhadhaa har jeeau dhur too rakhadhaa aaiaa ||

en.bdb: You always preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Dear Lord; You have protected them from the very beginning of time.

verse.unicode: ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦ ਜਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲਏ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਹਰਣਾਖਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਚਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: prahilaadh jan tudh raakh le har jeeau haranaakhas maar pachaiaa ||

en.bdb: You protected Your servant Prahlaad, O Dear Lord, and annihilated Harnaakhash.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: gurmukhaa no parateet hai har jeeau manmukh bharam bhulaiaa ||1||

en.bdb: The Gurmukhs place their faith in the Dear Lord, but the self-willed manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥

transliteration.english: har jee eh teree vaddiaaiee ||

en.bdb: O Dear Lord, this is Your Glory.

verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: bhagataa kee paij rakh too suaamee bhagat teree saranaiee || rahaau ||

en.bdb: You preserve the honor of Your devotees, O Lord Master; Your devotees seek Your Sanctuary. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਾ ਨੋ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਨੇੜੈ ਜਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bhagataa no jam joh na saakai kaal na neRai jaiee ||

en.bdb: The Messenger of Death cannot touch Your devotees; death cannot even approach them.

verse.unicode: ਕੇਵਲ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: keval raam naam man vasiaa naame hee mukat paiee ||

en.bdb: The Name of the Lord alone abides in their minds; through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they find liberation.

verse.unicode: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਭ ਭਗਤਾ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਗੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: ridh sidh sabh bhagataa charanee laagee gur kai sahaj subhaiee ||2||

en.bdb: Wealth and all the spiritual powers of the Siddhis fall at the feet of the Lord's devotees; they obtain peace and poise from the Guru. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੀ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭ ਸੁਆਉ ॥

transliteration.english: manmukhaa no parateet na aavee a(n)tar lobh suaau ||

en.bdb: The self-willed manmukhs have no faith; they are filled with greed and self-interest.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਭੇਦਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh hiradhai sabadh na bhedhio har naam na laagaa bhaau ||

en.bdb: They are not Gurmukh - they do not understand the Word of the Shabad in their hearts; they do not love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਕੂੜ ਕਪਟ ਪਾਜੁ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਫੀਕਾ ਅਲਾਉ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: kooR kapaT paaj leh jaasee manmukh feekaa alaau ||3||

en.bdb: Their masks of falsehood and hypocrisy shall fall off; the self-willed manmukhs speak with insipid words. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਭਗਤੀ ਹੂ ਤੂ ਜਾਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: bhagataa vich aap varatadhaa prabh jee bhagatee hoo too jaataa ||

en.bdb: You are pervading through Your devotees, O Dear God; through Your devotees, You are known.

verse.unicode: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਸਭ ਲੋਕ ਹੈ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥

transliteration.english: maiaa moh sabh lok hai teree too eko purakh bidhaataa ||

en.bdb: All the people are enticed by Maya; they are Yours, Lord - You alone are the Architect of Destiny.

verse.unicode: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ ॥੪॥

transliteration.english: haumai maar manasaa maneh samaanee gur kai sabadh pachhaataa ||4||

en.bdb: Overcoming my egotism and quieting the desires within my mind, I have come to realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||

verse.unicode: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: achi(n)t ka(n)m kareh prabh tin ke jin har kaa naam piaaraa ||

en.bdb: God automatically does the work of those who love the Name of the Lord.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: gur parasaadh sadhaa man vasiaa sabh kaaj savaaranahaaraa ||

en.bdb: By Guru's Grace, he ever dwells in their minds, and He resolves all their affairs.

verse.unicode: ਓਨਾ ਕੀ ਰੀਸ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਵਿਗੁਚੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੈ ਰਖਵਾਰਾ ॥੫॥

transliteration.english: onaa kee rees kare su viguchai jin har prabh hai rakhavaaraa ||5||

en.bdb: Whoever challenges them is destroyed; they have the Lord God as their Savior. ||5||

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur seve kinai na paiaa manmukh bhauk mue bilalaiee ||

en.bdb: Without serving the True Guru, no one finds the Lord; the self-willed manmukhs die crying out in pain.

verse.unicode: ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: aaveh jaaveh Thaur na paaveh dhukh meh dhukh samaiee ||

en.bdb: They come and go, and find no place of rest; in pain and suffering, they perish.

verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੬॥

transliteration.english: gurmukh hovai su a(n)mrit peevai sahaje saach samaiee ||6||

en.bdb: But one who becomes Gurmukh drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar, and is easily absorbed in the True Name. ||6||

verse.unicode: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਰੈ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: bin satigur seve janam na chhoddai je anek karam karai adhikaiee ||

en.bdb: Without serving the True Guru, one cannot escape reincarnation, even by performing numerous rituals.

verse.unicode: ਵੇਦ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੈ ਵਾਦ ਵਖਾਣਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: vedh paReh tai vaadh vakhaaneh bin har pat gavaiee ||

en.bdb: Those who read the Vedas, and argue and debate without the Lord, lose their honor.

verse.unicode: ਸਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਜਿ ਛੂਟਹਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੭॥

transliteration.english: sachaa satigur saachee jis baanee bhaj chhooTeh gur saranaiee ||7||

en.bdb: True is the True Guru, and True is the Word of His Bani; in the Guru's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||7||

verse.unicode: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: jin har man vasiaa se dhar saache dhar saachai sachiaaraa ||

en.bdb: Those whose minds are filled with the Lord are judged as true in the Court of the Lord; they are hailed as true in the True Court.

verse.unicode: ਓਨਾ ਦੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਹੋਈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥

transliteration.english: onaa dhee sobhaa jug jug hoiee koi na meTanahaaraa ||

en.bdb: Their praises echo throughout the ages, and no one can erase them.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥੮॥੧॥

transliteration.english: naanak tin kai sadh balihaarai jin har raakhiaa ur dhaaraa ||8||1||

en.bdb: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Lord within their hearts. ||8||1||
